product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice 16 AWG NEMA 5-15P to powerCON Connector 1.5FT
product.description: The Stage Right™ powerCON® Cable is the ideal power cable for powering many professional audio devices. The Neutrik® powerCON (NAC3FCA) connector is a 3-conductor, locking power connector, which provides a safer power connection than the IEC 60320 C13/C14 connectors commonly found on consumer audio components, computers, power adapters, and other devices. The twist connector mates the ground contact before connecting the neutral and line contacts, ensuring an electrically safe connection. It carries an IP65 ingress protection rating, which means that it is completely dust-tight. It can also withstand at least 3 minutes of a 1/4" direct water jet at a pressure of 4.3 psi (30 kPa), which means that it can withstand dripping water from light to medium rain for a short period of time.Features: 16 AWG pure, bare copper conductorsGenuine Neutrik® powerCON® (NAC3FCA) connectorSJT-rated jacketFast and easy twist lock latching system for additional safetyExtremely robust and reliableUL® and cUL tested componentsIP65 dust/water protection ratingStage Right™ and the Stage Right logo are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
